name: ChordRes with three velocity gains
tagline: Old velocity retention and separate gains on parallel and perpendicular displacement.
description: The position and branch paths follow saved-force ChordRes. The velocity update on the tangent plane independently weights the carried velocity and both displacement components at every attention/FFN site.
mechanism: Unit-RMS hidden state and a per-token tangent velocity
Independent scalar controls for each attention and FFN site
BF16 force tensors retained on the GPU for the fused Chord backward
Independent learned displacement gains at the 45 sites consumed by the next sublayer
limitations: Matched-normal research initialization with a scalar LR override. The 8,000-update segment is an intermediate checkpoint.
